problem_description: Use-after-free of the 9p session structure during RCU pathwalk because v9fs_kill_super frees it without an RCU grace period while v9fs_vfs_get_link_dotl accesses it.
Race condition in sched_ext where DSQ consume and move paths can operate on a task concurrently with the dispatcher because they do not wait for SCX_OPSS_DISPATCHING to clear.
Unmasking Advisory Non-Fatal Errors during PCI AER initialization causes spontaneous power loss on Apple T2 Secure Enclave devices.
Unnecessary PCIe error recovery is triggered on false alarms when no unmasked errors are actually signaled, leading to device probe failures.
NULL pointer dereference in current_is_workqueue_mem_reclaim because a kworker outside work-item execution can have a NULL current_pwq.
The NR_CPUS Kconfig range allows the 64-bit default value of 256 to leak into 32-bit builds, causing percpu area bloat and early boot hangs.
Incorrect format specifier %lu is used for a size_t variable in hugetlb-mmap, causing -Wformat compiler warnings on 32-bit builds.
NULL pointer dereference in __queue_work during early boot because pagetable_free_kernel attempts to schedule work on an uninitialized workqueue.
The FlexSPI DLL calibration fails because it is executed while the module is in stop mode, which gates the required serial root clock.
pci_enable_atomic_ops_to_root() incorrectly fails when no Root Port is visible in passthrough guests, preventing drivers from using supported AtomicOps.
Missing migration protection in __rhtab_map_lookup_and_delete_batch allows tasks to migrate between CPUs during the delete loop, triggering a BUG when this_cpu_ptr is called in preemptible code.
False positive WARN_ON in cleanup_srcu_struct due to using the racy rcu_segcblist_n_cbs instead of rcu_segcblist_empty to check for pending callbacks.
Using multiple SDMA schedulers for TTM entities causes random buffer object corruption with DCC on gfx12 hardware.
Library-based AES encryption modes incorrectly override architecture-optimized implementations due to crypto API template priority handling, causing performance regressions.
Library-based AES modes incorrectly override architecture-optimized implementations instantiated via templates due to limitations in the cra_priority mechanism, causing performance regressions.
Library-based AES implementations incorrectly override architecture-optimized implementations due to template instantiation priority issues, causing performance regressions.
Registering library-based AES encryption modes overrides architecture-optimized implementations instantiated via templates, leading to unintended use of slower single-block AES code.
Failed ATAPI commands completed through libata EH erroneously complete with a GOOD status byte instead of CHECK CONDITION because atapi_qc_complete() incorrectly relies on cmd->result being zero.
The commit removed a fallback mechanism for forward path discovery, breaking flowtable hardware offload for ieee80211 wireless devices.
A use-after-free occurs in the netfilter rbtree set because the garbage collector can scan and free newly added elements that are still in a transaction state before they are fully activated.
Auth session leak in the tpm2_get_random() error path due to a missing tpm2_end_auth_session() call when tpm_buf_fill_hmac_session() fails.
Unconditional fallback to cpuinfo.max_freq in cpufreq_update_pressure violates scheduler assumptions by applying cpufreq pressure when the CPU capacity reference frequency is unknown.

Circular locking dependency (deadlock) caused by acquiring the init_mm mmap read lock in the page attribute change path, which can be called during memory reclaim, while the same lock is held during a GFP_KERNEL allocation in pud_free_pmd_page.
Missing unregistration of the input device in the snd_probe error path leaves the input device registered after the card is freed, leading to a use-after-free.
Adding a PCI SSID quirk for the Lenovo Yoga Pro 9 16IAH10 breaks audio on other machines sharing the same PCI SSID by overriding their correct codec-SSID quirks.
The InterTouch quirk for the ThinkPad T440p incorrectly disables SMBus InterTouch on all devices with board id 2722, such as the L440, instead of restricting the quirk to the specific PNP ID.
Implicit padding in the UAPI struct allocinfo_counter causes a compiler error when testing headers with -Wpadded.
Missing size argument in the scx_bpf_cid_topo BPF kfunc prevents struct scx_cid_topo from growing without breaking backward compatibility or causing out-of-bounds writes.
Adding the vcpu_ids bitmap to struct kvm significantly increases the structure size, tripping a sanity check and causing build failures on x86 when CONFIG_DEBUG_KERNEL is disabled.
Allocating whole pages for RX buffers inflates the skb truesize, causing UDP sockets to drop packets and wasting memory on systems with large page sizes.
Direct mempool allocation callbacks skip the alloc_hooks wrapper, leading to missing allocation tagging and kernel warnings when memory allocation profiling debug is enabled.
The RTL931x MDIO driver incorrectly leaves the extended page field at zero during Clause 22 transactions, overriding page selections and breaking access to private PHY pages.
Build failure due to an unused function warning for qcom_geni_serial_poll_rx_fifo_locked when console support is disabled.
The 32-bit ruleset version counter can wrap around after repeated successful rule additions, causing different rule histories to alias to the same trace identity.
The test ops structs are exported globally using EXPORT_SYMBOL instead of EXPORT_SYMBOL_IF_KUNIT, polluting the global namespace and rendering the KUnit namespace import meaningless.
The serdev for the WCN7850 on the Lenovo ThinkPad T14s gen6 is not created because its PCI subdevice ID was omitted from the match table.

Active load balance loses the migrate_llc_task semantics because the CPU stopper constructs a fresh lb_env that does not inherit the migration type from the passive load-balance pass, potentially moving tasks away from their preferred LLC.
Using a non-lazy irq_work for console_msr_work raises an immediate IRQ upon queueing, which causes hangs on Tegra20 and Tegra30 platforms when atomic printing occurs while entering cpuidle states.
Renaming CONFIG_PROC_SYSCTL to CONFIG_SYSCTL in place leaves the entries out of alphabetical order in the net and packetdrill selftest configs, causing netdev CI checks to fail.
Insufficient skb length validation in rfcomm_recv_frame for frames with an extended 2-byte length field allows short frames to bypass checks and be incorrectly parsed.
The signal-scope denial tracepoint fails to record the effective signal number, causing permission-probe signal zero to be lost and making the file-owner hook's zero sentinel ambiguous.
The ptrace denial tracepoint fails to report the actual tracer task, preventing consumers from accurately identifying the tracer during PTRACE_TRACEME where the current task is the tracee.
The landlock_deny_access_net tracepoint reports ambiguous zero values for ports and allows typed BPF programs to read uninitialized bytes.
The Landlock rule tracepoints use a scalar access_mask_t argument that breaks BPF CO-RE forward compatibility and report inaccurate rule context data.
Tracepoint arguments passed by value use the growable access_mask_t type instead of a fixed u64, which breaks BPF CO-RE because it cannot widen scalar callback slots.
Filesystem topology denials are incorrectly rendered with an empty blockers value in tracepoints because they are identified by request type rather than an access mask.
The ethtool IOCTL path for ETHTOOL_TEST runs without rtnl_lock on ops-locked drivers, causing lockdep warnings and assertion failures when offline self-tests tear down and bring up the interface.
The DAMON core incorrectly clamps the effective quota size to the minimum region size instead of allowing it to be zero when the temporal quota goal has been achieved.

Incorrect assignment order of the filter and filter2 controls for EVICT_STATE_SEL events in the ARM CMN PMU driver, causing them to be programmed in the opposite order from the hardware specification.
False positive warning in set_task_cpu when proxy execution migrates a blocked, migration-disabled donor task.
Out-of-bounds read in bpf_binprm_select_interp due to a time-of-check to time-of-use race condition where a BPF map value can be modified concurrently between strnlen and strcmp.
Suspicious RCU usage warning in expect_iter_name due to using rcu_dereference without holding the RCU read lock instead of rcu_dereference_protected.

A circular locking dependency warning in lockdep disables it for the rest of the boot because namespace_sem is held during superblock allocation due to a cleanup attribute extending the lock's scope to the end of init_mount_tree.
Symlink reads from the cache return a rounded-up size because the iterator size is set to PAGE_SIZE, leading to incorrect symlink lengths and trailing garbage.
The default width of the interrupt target field in the Maili pinctrl driver does not match the actual register layout due to a missing intr_target_width initialization.
Missing initialization of the interrupt target field width in the PINGROUP macro results in an incorrect register layout configuration.
Missing intr_target_width configuration in the Nord pinctrl driver causes GPIO interrupts to be routed to the wrong target processor due to an incorrect default bitmask.
Missing transaction_report feature entry in rust_binderfs prevents userspace from determining if the BINDER_CMD_REPORT netlink API is supported.
Failure to allocate a private futex hash on vfork allows private futex waiters to exist before the hash is allocated.
Unclaimed register accesses occur on pipes not supporting selective fetch because plane disable logic uses a global display version check instead of a pipe-specific check.
Hardcoding the number of guest pages to 1 in check_steal_time_uapi causes test assertion failures on systems with host page sizes larger than 4K.
Incorrect status decoding for short WMT FUNC_CTRL events always treats them as failures instead of checking the header flag.
Missing string entry for MEMBLOCK_RSRV_HUGETLB in the flagname array prevents memblock debugfs from reporting the flag by name.
Undefined shift behavior in calc_allowed_config_filter due to passing a potentially negative index from iter_pos_to_idx directly to the BIT macro.
xchk_directory_data_bestfree unconditionally checks the padding field of directory blocks, incorrectly treating dir3_block blocks as if they have a padding field like dir3_data blocks.
Incorrect model ID range for Zen 5 Turin processors includes mobile processors, leading to bogus temperature reporting for non-existent CCDs.
Use-after-free of the parent's function graph return stack in copy_process because ftrace_graph_init_task is called after the fallible copy_exec_state operation.
Incorrect error handling condition in ttm_bo_alloc_at_place allows failed dmem cgroup charges to proceed, while the intended bulk_move removal in ttm_bo_swapout_cb is not executed on success.
Devmem TCP transmission without zero-copy is not properly rejected, allowing the mixing of net-iov and pages in a single SKB which breaks invariants.
Double accounting of user time on interrupt entry due to redundant calls to account_cpu_user_entry in arch_interrupt_enter_prepare and arch_enter_from_user_mode.
Incorrect assignment of the parsed maxim,over-volt property to chip->vmin instead of chip->vmax in max17042_parse_dt.
Unnecessary and expensive out-of-order queue pruning is triggered for out-of-window data packets that will be immediately dropped anyway.
Taking exec_update_lock in procfs creates a deadlock with do_close_on_exec() which holds the same lock while potentially blocking on filesystem operations.

When cgroup.memory=nokmem is set, the deferred split shrinker's list_lru initialization inherits a bogus shrinker ID of 0, causing an out-of-bounds warning in set_shrinker_bit() when deferred_split_folio() queues a THP.
Use-after-free in _update_opp_table_clk due to accessing opp_table->clk after freeing opp_table with dev_pm_opp_put_opp_table.

Unconditionally disabling remote wakeup capability for MT7922/MT7925 prevents the device from being used as a system wakeup source by userspace and applies the workaround too broadly across all platforms.
Setting the secondary fwnode on the ACPI companion device instead of the physical device causes GPIO lookups to fail.

A race condition exists between the deferred snd_soc_register_component execution and kexec reboot, which can cause device list corruption if registration occurs while device_shutdown is walking the lists.
The kernel.syscall_user_dispatch sysctl fails to register because it is guarded by the removed CONFIG_PROC_SYSCTL macro instead of CONFIG_SYSCTL.
Race condition in partition work handoff where pending requests can be missed if they arrive as the current runner finishes, delaying updates until the round-robin timer runs.
The driver incorrectly limits the maximum raw DAC value to 63 instead of 64, preventing userspace from selecting the full-scale output voltage.
The fq qdisc allows setting quantum to a very small value via tc qdisc change, which can cause a deficit spin.
Using local_irq_disable() in arch_interrupt_exit_prepare() overwrites irq_soft_mask and strips the IRQS_PMI_DISABLED bit during replayed interrupt exits.
Calling bpf_obj_free_fields from NMI context in resizable hashtab operations is unsafe when releasing referenced kptrs or complex fields.
Reinitializing special fields on insertion in resizable hashtabs clears pointers to active timers in recycled elements, potentially leading to use-after-free when callbacks run with freed memory.
Taking register snapshots before collecting linked registers in check_cond_jmp_op resurrects scalar IDs dropped by collect_linked_regs, leading to incorrect range adjustments.
Race condition in __slab_try_return_freelist due to missing list_lock allows concurrent slab removal and insertion, leading to list corruption and kernel panic.
The V2 VF loses its carrier state after a netdev down/up cycle because enic_open does not restore the previous link state notification from the PF.
Missing validation for key-less BTF in rhtab_map_check_btf allows invalid hash maps to be created, leading to a NULL pointer dereference when reading them back.
Restoring KUAP in arch_exit_to_user_mode_prepare is too early on PowerPC because platform-specific exit routines that can enable IRQs still run afterwards, leading to KUAP debug warnings.
Deadlock between EQ interrupt handlers performing XArray lookups and create-path XArray updates due to the use of non-IRQ-safe XArray helpers.
Precision backtracking for BPF_LD | BPF_{IND,ABS} instructions fails to handle the implicit subprogram exit edge, leading to segmentation faults or unsound state pruning.
The driver incorrectly attempts to flush the scatterlist of an imported buffer object during a sync operation instead of refusing the request, violating dma-buf semantics.
Integer truncation in IrqVectorRegistration::index when casting a usize index to u32 can cause wrap-around on 64-bit architectures, leading to incorrect IRQ vector resolution.
Setting the OF_POPULATED flag on a gpio-hog node in of_gpio_notify before verifying the parent GPIO chip exists causes the hog to be permanently ignored when the chip is registered later.

The DRIVER_PE_KUNIT_TEST Kconfig option incorrectly selects the OF subsystem, silently enabling additional kernel functionality and potentially increasing the attack vector, instead of skipping the test when OF is disabled.
Reverting the deduplication logic for typec muxes causes combo PHYs to be erroneously configured twice for USB super-speed and SBU/AUX lines.
Missing const qualifier for the old memory slot parameter in kvm_s390_update_cmma_dirty causes a compile-time warning.
Incorrectly resetting the hardware pointer masking mode when the tagged address ABI is disabled breaks the ability for userspace to enable pointer masking independently.
The TX queue can be inadvertently re-enabled by other network layers after a fatal error because it is not permanently disabled.
AttributeError in wq_dump.py when inspecting older kernels or vmcores due to missing backward compatibility for the wq->attrs rename.
Type confusion and invalid memory access in hp-wmi due to passing thermal parameters instead of board parameters as driver data for the 8DD6 board.
Missing device tree descriptions for PWM-driven power regulators causes Linux to treat them as unused and switch them off during boot, leading to random hangs and memory corruption.
The sd_3v3 regulator is incorrectly marked as always-on, preventing the MMC core from power cycling the SD card to recover from 1.8V switch failures.
Incorrect error code -EIO is returned instead of -EINVAL when a mount is completed from a mismatched user namespace.
Incorrect addition of MXC and MMCX power domains for Eliza that are not actually wired up at the hardware level.
Duplicate call to intel_pfit_compute_config in mst_stream_compute_config due to an erroneous cherry-pick.
When the interrupt timestamp interval is invalid, the estimated timestamp value can incorrectly exceed the actual interrupt timestamp.
Circular locking dependency in ipvlan_device_event because unregister_netdevice_many is called while holding the pnodes_lock mutex.
Multiuser SMB mounts with Kerberos fail because the username option is not duplicated when creating multiuser connections, preventing cifs.upcall from finding credentials in the keytab.
The MxL862xx driver enables FDB isolation but fails to enable assisted learning on the CPU port, causing stale hardware FDB entries and dropped traffic when clients roam to foreign bridge ports.
The big_tcp_tunnels test fails to produce BIG TCP packets in slow configurations because increased RTT limits sk_pacing_rate and caps SKBs.
The BIG TCP packet threshold in the UDP tunnels selftest is too high when checksum offload is disabled, causing false test failures due to lower throughput.
The big_tcp_tunnels.sh selftest uses a hardcoded packet threshold that is too high for slow debug kernels, causing the test to be flaky and fail on upstream CI runners.
Race condition in big_tcp_tunnels.sh where the test starts before netserver is fully listening, leading to test failures.
The dead flag for deleted or destroyed sets is not set early enough in the commit path, causing the set .commit operation to be incorrectly executed for sets that are being removed.
The DMI quirk for ASUS TUF FA401EA devices uses an overly specific product name string that fails to match all variants of the hardware.
The rusttest build target fails due to an ambiguous dependency on zerocopy_derive because the compiler finds both the sysroot copy and the locally built copy.
Checking in .bak backup files for rvgen kunit selftests causes clean targets like make distclean to remove them and leave the source tree dirty.

Shrinking struct vmpressure inadvertently moves memory event counters and the hot vmstats_percpu pointer onto the same cacheline in struct mem_cgroup, causing false sharing and a performance regression.
Incorrect reading of the U65 rounding mode as a storage mode causes valid command streams to fail with -EINVAL.

Applying the HCI_QUIRK_BROKEN_EXT_SCAN quirk to all RTL8761B devices breaks Bluetooth functionality on dongles that actually support extended scanning, causing them to fail and re-enumerate in an endless loop.
Use-after-free in L2CAP socket options when accessing conn->hcon because the channel connection reference extends the lifetime of conn beyond its associated hci_conn.
A command chain with a command count of zero passes the payload length check, leading to a zero-length buffer submission and a subsequent page fault during cache flush.
Switching lock guards to use nested interrupt disabling primitives breaks existing code that manually unlocks and relocks the spinlock inside the guard scope.
Incorrect network statistics accounting where successfully received packets are not counted in rx_packets and rx_bytes if the replacement skb allocation fails.
A TX queue stall occurs when the software USO transmission path exits early without ringing the doorbell for previously written buffer descriptors.
Combining completely overlapping resources during ACPI platform device registration breaks drivers that expect multiple identical resources to be present.
Pointer arithmetic on a nested fixed-size struct triggers a FORTIFY_SOURCE write overflow warning when populating the report buffer in the KUnit test.
Fastcommit replay crashes because ext4_mark_iloc_dirty incorrectly sets the I_METADATA_WRITEBACK flag, causing the filesystem to enter writeback paths before they are fully initialized.
Build failure on CONFIG_OF=n builds due to macb_alloc_tieoff and macb_free_tieoff being mistakenly declared inside a CONFIG_OF block but called unconditionally.
Out-of-bounds access in the BPF disassembler when reporting subprogram fallthrough diagnostics for an invalid signed double-word load instruction.
Incorrect assumption that missing reset_control_status support is specific to Gen5 devices leads to improper reset handling or probe failures depending on the firmware.
Creating an O_TMPFILE on an unsupported SMB server incorrectly returns ENOENT instead of EOPNOTSUPP.
Calling amdgpu_ttm_enable_buffer_funcs too early during minimal XGMI initialization fails because SDMA engines are not yet initialized, leaving TTM buffer functions permanently disabled.
Missing inclusion of linux/bitfield.h causes an implicit function declaration error for FIELD_GET during build.
The qcom-spmi-adc-tm5-gen3.c source file was accidentally omitted from the commit due to a manual patch application error, causing a build failure.
Missing RCU read lock around xfrm_nlmsg_multicast in xfrm_send_migrate_state triggers a suspicious RCU usage warning.
Unmet Kconfig dependencies and potential build breakage because VIDEO_QCOM_IRIS selects QCOM_UBWC_CONFIG without properly depending on QCOM_SMEM.
The internal NF_CT_EXPECT_DEAD flag is incorrectly exposed to userspace during netlink expectation dumps.
The check for inserting dead expectations is incomplete because it is placed in nf_ct_expect_related_report(), missing the nf_ct_expect_related_pair() insertion path.
Concurrent session updates can revive a closing connection or affect unrelated connections due to missing request_lock serialization and improper session binding checks.

The audio quirk for Lenovo Yoga Slim 7 14AKP10 incorrectly matches on the PCI SSID instead of the codec SSID and is placed after a colliding PCI quirk, preventing the fixup from being applied and leaving the bass speaker silent.
The BPF verifier diagnostics incorrectly discard function, file, and line attribution when the BTF source line string is empty.
Livepatch fails to load modules referencing vmlinux symbols because objtool incorrectly uses the patched module's name instead of 'vmlinux' for the klp relocation section name.
Build failure in BPF selftests because the compiler cannot resolve a nested UAPI include added to tools/include/linux/filter.h.

Incorrect dispatch context setup in scx_process_sync_ecaps uses the target CPU's context instead of the executing CPU's context, causing dispatch kfuncs to misoperate on a NULL or stale runqueue under core scheduling.
Incorrect format specifier for a size_t variable in qla29xx_process_rd_image causes a build error on 32-bit platforms.
A stale ACTION_AGAIN state escapes walk_pmd_range when a pmd_none check triggers a continue, causing walk_pud_range to erroneously retry the walk and invoke duplicate callbacks.
The BPF selftest chained_global_func_calls_success hardcodes instruction counts that fail on CPU v4 where LLVM emits fewer instructions.
The commit introduces a spinlock invocation at every MIDI output event in a hot path, causing a significant performance regression that requires conversion to RCU.

The MVIY_PERCPU macro incorrectly stringifies arguments that are already C string literals without a comma separator, causing older binutils to silently drop the mviy instruction and break per-CPU address register repair after task migration.
Adding the has_drm_ras check at the beginning of xe_ras_init causes an early return that incorrectly skips subsequent sysctrl initialization for platforms without the drm_ras feature.
The tc qdisc replace command fails in the so_txtime selftest if the root qdisc already has handle 1: and is of a different kind.
A heuristic in create_fake_symbols incorrectly skips the .kcfi_traps section when Clang emits an assembler-local label at offset 0, resulting in lost traps for patched functions in livepatch modules.
The newly added cid kfuncs are not included in the known sets of scx_kfunc_context_filter, allowing them to be incorrectly called from any BPF struct_ops program.
Returning NULL from wq_node_nr_active when the workqueue is not unbound leads to a NULL pointer dereference because callers do not check the return value.
Unconditional calls to local_irq_disable() in arm64_exit_to_kernel_mode confuse pNMI state tracking and trigger a warning when interrupts are already disabled.
The so_txtime selftest configures the ETF qdisc as the root qdisc, which drops background traffic without a socket or txtime and causes connectivity loss when the test is run across two hosts.
Missing clock initialization and management in the UltraRISC DP1000 PCIe driver prevents the controller from functioning and properly handling suspend/resume cycles.
Missing MODULE_DEVICE_TABLE for the OF match table prevents module auto-loading when the device tree node is present.
PINCTRL_GENERIC_MUX cannot be selected in menuconfig because it incorrectly depends on MULTIPLEXER, which can only be enabled indirectly.
The event packet length validation incorrectly checks against the maximum payload size, causing valid events with smaller payloads to be erroneously rejected.

Reverting the inode size during a short direct I/O write causes the subsequent buffered I/O fallback to skip waiting for existing ordered extents, leading to a kernel panic from overlapping ordered extents.
Validating trip temperatures before clamping them allows distinct out-of-range temperatures to clamp to the same hardware value, resulting in an invalid low and high threshold pair.
The tas675x_reg_defaults array is not sorted by register address, causing regcache_lookup_reg's binary search to fail and leaving some register defaults unreachable.

The FM25G01B and FM25G02B SPI NAND chips incorrectly use the generic read cache variants which specify two dummy bytes for the Quad I/O read operation instead of the required single dummy byte, leading to corrupted data.
Swapped ball suffixes for the dap2_din and dap2_dout pin groups result in incorrect primary mux functions and broken DAP2 audio.
Race condition in the generic netdev_work facility allows queuing work and taking a reference on a dead network device, leading to ref tracker warnings.
Lockless ethtool ioctl device lookups allow udev workers triggered by KOBJ_ADD to fail with -ENODEV because the device is not yet added to the network device list during registration.
Build failure on s390 when Rust is enabled without CONFIG_HAS_IOMEM due to missing ioremap and iounmap declarations in the generic Rust IO helpers.
The newly added arm64 seccomp_ptrace_x0_bypass selftest fails to build because the tools copy of linux/filter.h does not include its corresponding UAPI header.
Compilation errors in arm64 ABI selftests due to missing include paths for kernel headers and missing asm/unistd.h inclusion.
The arm64 ABI selftests fail to compile due to missing include paths for kernel headers and a hardcoded __NR_write macro.
Multiple definitions of global BTF ID list symbols occur when two translation units instantiate the same event class, causing build failures.
Missing pre_unprepare delay for the TM156VDXP25 panel causes a violation of eDP power-off timing specifications.
Eagerly mapping all PCI BARs without checking the non_mappable_bars flag causes vmalloc warnings for devices with huge, unmappable BARs.
The USB QMP PHY vdda-phy and vdda-pll supplies are swapped in the device tree, feeding incorrect voltages to the PHY and PLL.
The USB QMP PHY vdda-phy and vdda-pll supplies are swapped in the device tree, providing incorrect voltages to the PHY and PLL.
Swapped USB QMP PHY vdda-phy and vdda-pll voltage supplies in the device tree feed incorrect voltages to the PHY.
Swapped USB QMP PHY vdda-phy and vdda-pll voltage supplies in the device tree feed incorrect voltages to the hardware.
Swapped vdda-phy and vdda-pll voltage supplies in the USB QMP PHY device tree node feed incorrect voltages to the PHY.
The USB QMP PHY vdda-phy and vdda-pll supplies are swapped in the device tree, feeding incorrect voltages to the PHY and PLL.
Writing to nr_hugepages fails with EINVAL on systems that do not support runtime allocation of gigantic hugepages, causing the selftest to abort instead of gracefully continuing.
Compile-time division by zero on UP builds due to using ARRAY_SIZE on an array of spinlocks, which have zero size when SMP and spinlock debugging are disabled.
Significant recording noise on Lenovo Yoga Pro 7 15ASH11 and Legion 7 15ASH11 due to missing limitation on internal microphone Amp-In values.
Build failure with LLVM's integrated assembler due to missing .option norelax causing out-of-range relocation errors for RUNTIME_MAGIC.
The f2fs_iostat tracepoint hardcodes the read folio count array size to 11, which silently truncates and drops higher-order folio counts on architectures where NR_PAGE_ORDERS exceeds 11.

Setting LED_CORE_SUSPENDRESUME causes the LED core to send a blocking request to a disappearing HID device during system resume on T2 Macs, resulting in the backlight failing to restore and staying off.
Unconditional application of the authenticated maximum PDU size limit during decompression allows unauthenticated clients to trigger excessive memory allocations.
Missing validation of compression flags and chained mode negotiation before memory allocation in ksmbd_decompress_request allows a remote attacker to trigger large transient memory allocations.
The SMB2 compression decoder accepts Pattern_V1 payloads even when they were not negotiated by the client.
Build failure in bpf_jit_emit_func_call_rel due to an unused variable 'ret' when CONFIG_PPC_KERNEL_PCREL is enabled.
Memory leak of pinctrl maps in pinctrl_generic_to_map() due to missing deallocation when subsequent map addition or configuration parsing steps fail.
Build failure in rusttest due to the compiler finding multiple candidates for the zerocopy dependency because an explicit path was not provided.
Unconditional linking of the VFIO library in KVM selftests causes cross-compilation issues on non-x86 architectures due to unnecessary dependencies.
Missing stub for sdca_fdl_free_state causes build failures when FDL support is not built into the kernel.
EAPOL frames for non-MLD stations egress from the wrong BSS because their link_id is left as UNSPECIFIED, which skips the per-link lookup and leaves the omac index at 0.
Incorrect printk format specifier %lu is used for a size_t argument in heci_write_hbuf and heci_read_hbuf, causing build errors on 32-bit platforms.
Missing ARM64 dependency in Kconfig causes a build failure on 32-bit ARM thumb2 builds with clang due to the use of arm_smccc_1_1_invoke.
Build failure due to an undefined symbol when CONFIG_DMA_SHARED_BUFFER is disabled because the dma-resv helper is included unconditionally.
Kunit tests running in kthreads fail to resolve paths or interact with initramfs because kthreads now start in nullfs by default, requiring the tests to explicitly override the init fs.

The Shikra pinctrl driver omits the intr_target_width configuration, causing it to default to a 3-bit mask instead of the hardware-required 4 bits, which can corrupt adjacent bits and mis-route interrupts.
Incorrect use of test_ctl_hi1_val instead of test_ctl_hi_val in DEFAULT_EVO PLL configurations prevents the test control register from being programmed correctly.
The ADSP remoteproc node is missing the required fallback compatible string for SM8550, which can prevent the driver from properly matching and probing the device.
The PCIe iommu-map entries specify only one cell for the SID, omitting the SID mask required by the apps_smmu provider which uses 2 iommu-cells.
Missing eUSB2 repeater regulator supplies in the Eliza CQS SoM device tree causes the hardware to be unpowered and malfunction.
Missing vbus-supply property in the Type-C connector device tree node causes a warning and fallback to a dummy regulator.
Clearing CON_PRINTBUFFER during 8250 port re-registration causes the console to start at the end of the printk ring buffer, losing all messages logged before UART registration.
Missing mutex_destroy for l2_lock causes warnings or issues when CONFIG_DEBUG_MUTEXES is enabled.
Missing mutex_destroy for vlan_lock causes debug warnings when the lock is discarded with CONFIG_DEBUG_MUTEXES enabled.
NULL pointer dereference in psp_nl_multicast_per_ns due to a race condition with concurrent network namespace teardown.
Incorrect assignment of the Zen6 CPU feature flag to Zen5 CPU models 0xd0 through 0xd7 in family 0x1a.
Missing validation in the vm_bind ioctl path allows user-space mappings to intersect with the address space carve-out reserved for kernel buffer objects.
Missing kobject_del in the error path of damos_sysfs_populate_region_dir causes directory creation failures due to name conflicts when kobject release is delayed.
Missing kobject_del() in the error path of damon_sysfs_probes_add_dirs() causes directory creation failures due to name conflicts.
Device tree schema validation fails for the ethernet PHY node on the K3 com260 board because the node name is 'phy' instead of 'ethernet-phy'.
Device tree schema validation fails for the ethernet PHY node on the K3 pico-itx board because the node name is phy instead of ethernet-phy.
Build failure in the ext4 module due to the undefined symbol __inode_attach_wb when CONFIG_CGROUP_WRITEBACK is enabled.

Calling nap_adjust_return() after irq_exit_rcu() in async interrupt handlers allows nested interrupts to erroneously redirect their return address to the idle nap return path, causing stack corruption and system panics on PPC970.

A link error occurs on ARM when the PMC driver is disabled because the dummy implementation of tegra_pmc_core_domain_state_synced is not provided.
Missing include of asm/insn.h in arch/arm64/kernel/static_call.c causes an implicit function declaration build error for aarch64_insn_adrp_get_offset.
The RS485 RTS polarity is incorrectly configured as active low instead of active high in the device tree for the imx95-verdin-ivy board, breaking RS485 functionality.
Strict length validation for WMT FUNC_CTRL events incorrectly rejects short packets from certain MediaTek devices, rendering them unusable.
Missing .iotlb_sync calls for drivers that do not use the iotlb_gather mechanism because the core code incorrectly assumes empty gathers mean nothing to sync.
